setting.name: Disable Hibernation
setting.casual_explanation: This turns off Windows hibernation so the system stops using hiberfil.sys and frees that disk space.
setting.why_people_change_it: People disable hibernation when they want to reclaim disk space or never use hibernate on that machine.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Disabling hibernation frees space and removes the hibernate option. The live app already supports rollback, but the card itself has not yet gone through the research-provider promotion path.
setting.professional_notes: The current app models this card as a command tweak that detects with powercfg /availablesleepstates, applies powercfg /hibernate off, and restores the previous state with powercfg /hibernate on when rollback is appropriate. Repo power docs and tweak provenance both map the tweak id to that same action. This record stays review-required until the command-backed power surface is promoted into the validated research-provider lane.

evidence.title: RegProbe app QA not-applicable observation for power.disable-hibernation
evidence.summary: Status not-applicable: Current state: Hibernation unavailable: system firmware does not support hibernation. The app now reports the firmware-limited VM state as not applicable and skips apply/rollback instead of producing a false failure.

decision.why: The app mapping is documented, but the available VM firmware does not support hibernation. The 2026-05-07 QA run now proves correct not-applicable handling rather than apply/rollback mutation behavior.
